notes.title: We're back
notes.content:
[p]New main gamemode: Conquest

Map: City (for now, lots of intentions with this new map)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226676/f599d39170b5d1ade46f2d0fa5ed7fe2df079e3f.png"][/img]
- Collect chips and deliver them, capture objectives or eliminate players to accumulate points for your team

New scoring system, only points counted, not KDA ratios

Disabled map selection for focus on the main gamemode, all will come back but changes in the overall architecture will demand time for adaptation[/p][p][/p][p]Some new equipment, not all fully developed

Full BHop enabled for all characters (Hold Jump to Bhop)

New dash system: Dashing torwards where you're looking

Wall grinding: You slow your fall when hugging a wall, can conserve horizontal speed and while grinding you can always wall-jump

Lots of stuff being made, for now we need testing

Feedback is appreciated, the main focus for now with this gamemode is to try and understand what makes a good objective map, and get the game to feel right. When thats done, we can start getting some new content and polishing what we already have[/p]

notes.title: Last update for awhile
notes.content:
So... i got a job! In a place where I really wanted to work and I'll focus on my carreer for now.

Some weapons and equipments added, not everything is finished from them.

Updates will be even slower now, many ideas but now I have to focus on my actual carrer.

Thanks for everyone who played it for the time being, development WILL continue but considerably slower, this is a passion project.

Any suggestions, send me an email and I'll try to get back to you, thanks!

notes.title: Mech melee and going forward
notes.content:
New Mech Melee ('Q' default, same as 'sub-skill')

New animations for melee and slightly remade torso models

New shoulder weapon for mechs, the double barrel shotgun

New map for mechs

Removed boosters from torso, unique booster models will come

Less focus on the 'default' mode for now, feeling like remaking all of it with my new experience making mechs and I think I can make it way better and fun in the future, by having you assemble your android as well

More to come, mainly in mech content for now, but I will remake the humanoid characters and game

Maps are simple but I need to get my own idea on how to make them better, for now they are usable, minimum viable product, but they can be great, I'm just not ready yet

Hope you have fun and I'll answer any suggestions or feedback.

notes.title: Mecha
notes.content:
We got mechas now or 'AC at home' as i'd like to call.

At the game lobby, there is a 'Test Zone (Mecha FFA)' Map that you can choose to play it.

- For now there are few parts, 2 weapons and 2 shoulder weapons
- Melee is intended in the future
- Heads are only cosmetic
- There is only one coolant type with a passive reduction in heat

Your character is red but i'm working on color selection.

More game-modes are intended for the mecha mode, maybe even a crossover with the normal 'android' mode.

I'm pushing this update for testing purposes, mainly to see if its actually fun to play, feedback is always appreciated.

notes.title: InputMap fixes
notes.content: Fixed some bugs with input mapping, Primary and Secondary fire are default for Mouse 1 and Mouse 2, be careful when mapping to mouse buttons, might not work. Low priority issue for the time being.

notes.title: New Character and Menu Functions
notes.content:
As seen previously, a new character has been added, the Hunter kit. And new input mapping fucnionalities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226676/e3b8108f9e935e085214f7402212718ab52c4c96.png[/img]

The hunter kit has:
- 75 shields (light class)
- Chaged bow
- Snare Trap
- Sonar pulse (reveals enemy players)

Having done 2 debuffs for this kit will pave the path for more to come.

The mouse mapping is a bit buggy for now, just in the loading department, as it shows 'UNSET' when loaded but it still works.

- You can now save your configs automatically, both audio, mouse sensitivity and keymapping.

- Changed some aspects of the TAB player list (removed backgrounds)

Questions, feedback or suggestions you can contact me here: upgradedgamecontact@gmail.com
